# cloud-migration-risk-framework
> Risk framework for large cloud migrations: threat model, rollback criteria, SEV model, go/no-go gates, communication plans.

Part of **Boryslav Deputat** public engineering portfolio (Austin, TX). Built with KLAV (UA AI) / КЛАВ (УКР ШІ).
